title: vpg pairwise judge packet (vpg-judge-packet/v1)
description: What a judging agent receives (`vpg judge pack`). Items are blinded (S01, S02, ...); the batch hides a reference and a degraded anchor among them; every pair appears twice, once in each order. The key that unblinds it is kept apart and never given to the judge.

criterion.description: one criterion per batch, e.g. a rubric dimension or a spec rule's intent

rules.description: spec rule ids the judge must cite

path.description: a neutral copy, <media dir>/<label>/<key><ext> relative to the packet, staged by vpg judge pack; never the original file name

sha256.description: the copy's sha256, given only when its bytes differ from the original's (remuxed audio or video)
